mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in FEDFUNDS signals monetary easing, lowering discount rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS does not decline significantly or 20-day returns remain non-positive despite the signal.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL crossing above 240 indicates rising inflation expectations, prompting Fed rate hikes that compress growth and depress equity valuations, generating negative 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are positive despite CPIAUCSL exceeding 240 or Fed rate hikes are insufficient.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in FEDFUNDS and rises in GDPC1 signal accommodative monetary policy and robust demand growth, amplifying equity valuation gains and driving positive 60-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS falls while GDPC1 rises over the next month
failure_condition: Either proxy fails to move in expected direction or 60-day returns are not significantly positive.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion, simultaneous peaks in GDPC1 (demand) and PAYEMS (labor) reflect strong economic momentum, fostering investor confidence and positive 20-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 and PAYEMS both exceed their 2016 August levels
failure_condition: Returns are not positive despite both proxies exceeding 2016 levels or the regime is not in late-cycle.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained falls in UNRATE below 4.5% signal tight labor markets, stimulating economic activity and corporate profits, which drive positive short-term (5-day) S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 5-day returns are negative despite UNRATE falling below 4.5% or the unemployment rate does not trend downward.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in INDPRO below 98 signals contraction in business output, reducing growth prospects and leading to negative 60-day forward returns as investors anticipate economic slowdown.
failure_condition: 60-day returns are positive despite INDPRO falling below 98 or the contraction reverses quickly.

mechanism_narrative: Rising RSAFS (demand) coupled with falling FEDFUNDS (easing) creates a dual signal of strong spending and accommodative policy, enhancing equity valuations and generating positive 20-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS rises while FEDFUNDS falls over the next month
failure_condition: Either proxy moves contrary to expected direction or returns are not positive.

mechanism_narrative: FEDFUNDS rising above 0.4% alongside CPIAUCSL falling below 240.101 signals a shift to tightening policy amid cooling inflation, fostering recovery and positive short-term (5-day) S&P 500 returns.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above 0.4% while CPIAUCSL crosses below 240.101
failure_condition: Returns are negative despite the regime conditions or the proxies do not cross in the expected direction.
